title: Match fined $10 million for alleged Tinder privacy violations
content_md: Ireland’s data protection regulator will fine the Match Group as a result of the dating app Tinder allegedly failing to provide users with their personal data held by the company upon request.
exclude_reason: Irish regulator fine over Tinder handling of personal-data access requests; privacy compliance news mechanically misclustered into an unrelated Google fine story, no security incident substance.
